description: A vehicle USD on 4 ANCF FEM tires over a terrain bundle (--terrain boulders | craters | rellis_00000..rellis_00004: newton-terrain-tool bakes and newton-rellis-3d-tool reconstructions, one format; run-examples.sh asks which terrain and which vehicle USD, Warthog default). The vehicle spawns at pose 0 of the bundle's reference track (position + heading; the origin heading +x when there is none). --controller manual = the base sliders / CTIS panel and the driving keys (I/K throttle, J/L steer, SPACE stop; WASD / QE + mouse are the viewer's free-camera gaming controls); track = pure pursuit on the reference track (lookahead max(lookahead-min, lookahead-time * v)) gives the yaw-rate command, the speed is capped in bends (a-lat; 0 = flat out): a kingpin-steered vehicle (super-jeep) turns it into a steer angle through the bicycle model, a skid-steered one (Sherp, Warthog) into brake levers through the drive kinematics (yaw-authority, default 1 = no slip; no PID: the wheel motors hold the wheel speeds). Turns = the stretches of the track bending one way (from its curvature; boulders = the flower, 16 turns); every turn gets yaw IAE / RMS / lateral RMS / time-to-band (none on straights or outside the corridor +-corridor-half-width: null = the bundle's baked half width, else 4 m); switch-pressure-turns / switch-stage-turns alternate the condition (CTIS at the real fill rate; a stage change re-drops = new episode); --log file.npz stores the signals + per-turn metrics. Any driving key or slider hands over to manual. Terrain stage w (heights = w * I_N) changes live from the UI (slider / buttons: ANCF contact grid, MuJoCo collider and the terrain mesh rescale, the vehicle is re-dropped at the spawn). HUD: yaw / speed strip charts (command grey, measured orange), drive bars, per-turn IAE bars, minimap with arena, corridor and trail; scene: orange commanded arc, cyan measured arc, blue trail, yellow reference track. Camera free (default; --camera) / follow / top, sun / ambient sliders, MuJoCo collider + contact overlays, watchdog (dumps the last frames and resets on a sim fault). Rigid parts collide with the fine 0.25 m grid (vendored mujoco_warp: 128 hfield prisms per geom). Sherp pressure 10342 Pa = 1.5 psi (real CTIS panel midpoint 0.9-2.1 psi; the generic 30000 Pa overinflates the Sherp's 5.9 kN/corner tire). kn / kd / pcg-iters null = tire asset recommendation.
